test.title: A green place in your city

document.cue: Describe a place in your city where there are many trees and plants.

text: I want to talk about a big park in my city. It is called Central Park and it is near the centre, so I can get there by bus in about fifteen minutes. It is not far from my house, and that is one reason I like it. It is also very popular with people from my area.

In the park there are a lot of tall trees, flowers and a small lake. In spring the flowers are very beautiful, and in summer the trees give a lot of shade. There are also some ducks on the lake, and children like to feed them. People do many things there. Some people run or ride bicycles, and old people sit on the benches and talk. At the weekend families come with food and have a picnic. I usually go there with my friends, maybe two or three times a month, and we just walk and take photos.

I like this place because the air is fresh and it is quiet. My city is very busy and there are many cars, so the park is a good place to relax. When I have a lot of homework or I feel tired, I go there and I feel better. I think every city needs more parks like this, because green places are good for people and for nature. Also, it is free, so everybody can enjoy it.

tips.en: Words like so, because and also connect ideas even when the grammar is simple.
tips.kk: So, because және also сөздері грамматика қарапайым болса да ойларды байланыстырады.
tips.ru: Слова so, because и also помогают связать идеи, даже когда грамматика простая.
tips.example: so I can get there by bus in about fifteen minutes

tips.en: Nature words such as shade, lake and benches make the description concrete.
tips.kk: Табиғатқа қатысты сөздер (shade, lake, benches) сипаттаманы нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Слова про природу (shade, lake, benches) делают описание конкретным.
tips.example: the trees give a lot of shade

note.kk: Ауызекі сөйлеуге арналған әмбебап мөлшер сөзі.

note.en: A fixed collocation for eating outdoors.
Names the place, where it is and how to get there, covering the first bullet.
note.kk: Орынды, оның қайда екенін және қалай баруға болатынын атайды — картаның бірінші тармағы жабылды.
note.ru: Называет место, где оно находится и как туда добраться — первый пункт карточки закрыт.

note.en: Describes what you can see and what people do, then adds a personal detail (who with and how often).
note.kk: Не көруге болатынын және адамдардың не істейтінін сипаттайды, сосын жеке мәлімет қосады (кіммен және қаншалықты жиі).
note.ru: Описывает, что можно увидеть и что делают люди, затем добавляет личную деталь (с кем и как часто).

note.en: Explains why the speaker likes it: a reason, a personal example and a short closing thought.
note.kk: Орын неге ұнайтынын түсіндіреді: себеп, жеке мысал және қысқа қорытынды.
note.ru: Объясняет, почему место нравится: причина, личный пример и короткий вывод.

document.title: A green place in your city
bullets: and explain why you like this place.
